categories.title: Standards and specifications
categories.scope: Semantic conventions, wire protocols and context propagation standards that agent telemetry is built on.

categories.title: Instrumentation
categories.scope: Libraries and SDKs that produce telemetry from LLM clients, agent frameworks and services.

categories.title: Agent frameworks
categories.scope: Frameworks for building agents, with a note on how each one emits telemetry.

categories.title: Agent protocols and tool servers
categories.scope: SDKs and servers for agent protocols such as MCP and A2A, and how they carry traces.

categories.title: Collectors and pipelines
categories.scope: Collector distributions and components that receive, process, redact and route agent telemetry.

categories.title: Platforms
categories.scope: Products and backends that store, query and visualize agent telemetry.

subcategories.title: LLM and agent observability platforms
subcategories.scope: Platforms built for tracing, evaluating and monitoring LLM applications and agents.

subcategories.title: General APM with GenAI support
subcategories.scope: Application performance monitoring products with features for LLM and agent workloads.

subcategories.title: Trace backends and UIs
subcategories.scope: General backends and front ends for traces, metrics and logs that accept agent telemetry.

subcategories.title: Cloud provider offerings
subcategories.scope: Observability features of the agent runtimes and AI platforms of cloud providers.

subcategories.title: Model serving
subcategories.scope: Inference and serving engines and the telemetry they expose, such as Prometheus metrics.

categories.title: Gateways and proxies
categories.scope: Gateways and proxies for model and agent traffic that record or export telemetry.

categories.title: Evaluation and testing
categories.scope: Evaluation, testing and simulation tools with a documented link to traces or observability.

categories.title: Cost and usage
categories.scope: Token accounting, budgets and cost attribution for agents.

categories.title: Safety signals
categories.scope: Guardrails and runtime monitoring that emit telemetry, limited to their observability side.

categories.title: On-chain agents and payments
categories.scope: Tracing, protocols and infrastructure for agents that send transactions or make payments.

subcategories.title: Transaction tracing
subcategories.scope: Tools and documentation for tracing, replaying and debugging on-chain transactions, including those sent by agents and services.

subcategories.title: Payment protocols
subcategories.scope: Protocols and SDKs for payments made by agents, such as x402, MPP, AP2 and ACP.

subcategories.title: RPC and node observability
subcategories.scope: RPC interfaces, proxies and nodes, and the telemetry they expose.

subcategories.title: Wallets and smart accounts
subcategories.scope: Wallet SDKs, client libraries and smart account infrastructure used by agents.

subcategories.title: Local and test chains
subcategories.scope: Local nodes and toolkits for testing transactions without a public network.

categories.title: Findings
categories.scope: Compatibility notes and bugs that affect agent telemetry, each with public evidence such as an upstream issue.

categories.title: Benchmarks and datasets
categories.scope: Agent trace datasets and observability benchmarks.

categories.title: Learning
categories.scope: Articles, books, talks, papers, courses and case studies on observing agents.

subcategories.title: Articles and guides
subcategories.scope: Blog posts, official guides and demo applications.

subcategories.title: Books
subcategories.scope: Books on agent or LLM observability, and on the observability and OpenTelemetry practice they build on.

subcategories.title: Talks and videos
subcategories.scope: Conference sessions, videos and podcast episodes with a public page.

subcategories.title: Papers
subcategories.scope: Research papers on agent tracing, evaluation and monitoring.

subcategories.title: Case studies
subcategories.scope: Public write-ups of how organizations observe agents in production, by industry.

categories.title: Community
categories.scope: Working groups, meetings and channels where agent observability is discussed.

categories.title: Related lists
categories.scope: Other curated lists that cover parts of this topic.
